# jamfplatform_pro_mdm_profile_settings (Data Source)

Read the current Jamf Pro device communication settings (Settings → Device communication → MDM profile settings). Singleton — one record per tenant.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Global settings | MDM profile renewal settings | Read | `mdm-profile-renewal-settings` |



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `auto_renew_computer_profile_before_expiry` (Boolean) Automatically renew the computer MDM profile before its device identity certificate expires.
- `auto_renew_computer_profile_when_ca_renewed` (Boolean) When the certificate authority is renewed, automatically renew the computer MDM profile.
- `auto_renew_mobile_device_profile_before_expiry` (Boolean) Automatically renew the mobile device MDM profile before its device identity certificate expires.
- `auto_renew_mobile_device_profile_when_ca_renewed` (Boolean) When the certificate authority is renewed, automatically renew the mobile device MDM profile.
- `computer_profile_expiration_limit_days` (Number) Number of days before the computer device identity certificate expires at which Jamf Pro begins renewing the MDM profile.
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.
- `mobile_device_profile_expiration_limit_days` (Number) Number of days before the mobile device identity certificate expires at which Jamf Pro begins renewing the MDM profile.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
